scenes.name: THE PUZZLE
lines: Hanna's sequence begins one, one, two, five. But its formula is full of fractions.
Hanna 数列以 1、1、2、5 开头，公式里却满是分数。
Does every coefficient turn out to be an integer?
每一项最后都会是整数吗？

scenes.name: ONE COEFFICIENT
lines: To reach degree three, take the three pairs whose indices add to three.
要得到三次项，就取坐标之和等于 3 的三对数。
Their contributions to the logarithm are one, two, and one third.
它们对对数级数的贡献是 1、2 和三分之一。
After exponentiating, ten thirds plus three halves plus one sixth is five.
取指数以后，三分之十加二分之三再加六分之一，正好等于 5。

scenes.name: EVERY DEGREE
lines: A product of geometric series has integer coefficients without cancellation.
几何级数的乘积不需要约分，系数自然都是整数。
Prime by prime, the paper pairs entries on scaled diagonals. Their congruences make the exponents of the Euler product integers.
论文对每个素数，把缩放前后的斜线项配对；同余保证欧拉乘积的指数都是整数。

scenes.name: THE PAYOFF
lines: The product explains every degree at once. But lower the original power by one, and a fraction already appears in degree six.
乘积一次解释了所有次数。但把原来的指数减 1，六次项就出现了分数。
